account: It is day 0, about 09:00. I came from home to town hall and read the appointment book left by the secretary. Today's business is correspondence in the office, a market walk in the plaza at 10:00, lunch at home at noon, town accounts at 13:00, tea with the neighbour at an east-bank dockside cottage at 15:00, office again at 16:30, and home at 19:00. Tomorrow includes a mill grain inspection at 10:00. The secretary is beside me holding a writable book. I asked about correspondence and town news, but have not heard a reply. Several townsfolk have passed near the hall; I have not spoken with them or learned their purposes. Nothing unusual has been established: I have seen no incident, heard no news, and have no evidence of any special activity or hidden purpose.
